name: Gust Footspike
description: Thrust from the front rank as the rank behind readies its own thrust over your shoulders.

name: Chime Mastlength
description: Raise the rear rank's pikes above the front to cover the front men from falling blows.

name: Mastblink
description: Count the pace together so both ranks step on the same beat without crowding.

name: Echoing Pikeshoe
description: Send a thrust that the rank behind echoes through the same line, each carrying a thread of qi.

name: Pikerespite
description: Link qi between the front and rear ranks so each pikeman feels the other's shaft through the grip.

name: Brace Vortex
description: Exchange places between the ranks in two steps with no break in the bristling line.

name: Punishing Couchout
description: Both ranks thrust in one pulse with qi flowing in step, a double blow along a single line.

name: Thorn Pikeshaft
description: Lock the two ranks' crossed points with qi into one guard that no single foe can pass.

name: Berserk Steelcap Ruin
description: Gather both ranks' field qi into one pike and loose a thrust that pierces the strongest armour.

name: Mightpike
description: Crouch low and gather qi in the legs, like a hawk on its perch before the leap.

name: Pikeruin
description: Jab down along a slanting line from a raised stance, the point dropping onto the foe's shoulder.

name: Indomitable Pikecollar
description: Fold the arms in on landing and turn the shaft across the body, catching a counter-cut.

name: Might Pikebands
description: Step down a slope's edge with the pike held high so the point never dips.

name: Marking Ashstaff
description: Fix the gaze and the qi on one foe in a crowd and mark his every shift.

name: Plunging Levelhold
description: Leap and drop the pike point-first onto a foe, qi gathering at the head on the way down.

name: Ponderous Longpole
description: Clamp the shaft down on a foe's weapon like a talon and pin it to the ground with qi.

name: Silt Pikeshoe
description: Spring back and upward on a pulse of qi, as a hawk lifts on an updraft, keeping the pike levelled.

name: Tempered Bristle
description: Fall onto a raised shield with qi-loaded point and shatter its boss and the arm behind it.

name: Daybreak Press
description: Land with the pike swept wide on both sides, qi widening the arc across every foe beside you.

name: Lightning Levelhold
description: Vanish upward in a field-qi leap, then fall pike-first from above the foe's sight onto him.

name: Might Footspike
description: Gather qi low in the shaft's butt like water pooling in a basin before it is poured out.

name: Might Present
description: Drive both hands forward together on the shaft, jabbing straight from the low-gathered stance.

name: Thornshaft
description: Raise the shaft in a rim-like circle before the body to contain and turn aside a blow.

name: Couchout Flash
description: Walk in even matched strides, the pike's butt dragging low so the gathered qi stays settled.

name: Shaftscourge
description: Pour the gathered low qi up the shaft in one rush, driving the point through armour.

name: Charter Pikebands
description: Spread two crossed pikes like twin rims and press the foe's weapon between them to the ground.

name: Glamour Steelcap
description: Let a blow fill the basin of the brace, then spill its force back up the shaft at the attacker.

name: Heavy Press
description: Drive a heavy thrust with both hands and the whole basin of low qi behind the point.

name: Pikevalor
description: Hold a perfectly still brace with qi settled like quiet water, so a charge breaks without ripple.

name: Pitiless Longpole Havoc
description: Release the whole gathered basin of field qi in matched sweeping strokes that strike every foe at the front.

name: Vital Pikehead
description: Draw qi from the legs up through the grip like a river drawn from its source.

name: Gustpress
description: Jab along the foe's own motion, as a boat follows a current, to land without resistance.

name: Adamantine Mastlength
description: Shift the shaft to the bank side of a blow so it flows past the body.

name: Silt Pikeshaft
description: Cross broken ground in careful stepping strides, as over a ford, with the pike held levelled.

name: Mayhem Pikecollar
description: Spin the shaft in a tight eddy that catches a foe's weapon and drags it from line.

name: Wrathful Bristle
description: Merge two currents of qi, one from each hand, into the point as they meet at the head.

name: Fastening Brace
description: Draw a foe's weapon in the pull of both hands' qi and hold it against your shaft.

name: Thornmast
description: Hold the brace against the push with qi dragging low like an undertow, stealing the charge's force.

name: Waningpike
description: Let field qi widen out like a river mouth and sense every foe moving within reach.

name: Glint Pikebands
description: Thrust with the swollen weight of a river in spate, field qi carrying the point through plate.

name: Downpour Ashstaff
description: Sweep the pike low and wide as a flood spreads, qi extending the stroke across a line of foes.

name: Unconquered Pikecollar
description: Dam the charge on the braced shaft with field qi, then loose the held weight in one counter thrust.

name: Mayhem Present
description: Let two great currents of field qi meet at the point and burst forward in one flooding stroke.

name: Pikehead Insight
description: Run one track of qi through each hand so both grips hold the heavy pike with equal strength.

name: Rumble Pikeshoe
description: Drive the lead hand's track forward in a hard jab while the rear hand holds the line.

name: Granite Footspike
description: Push forward with the rear hand's track while the lead hand holds the shaft against a charge.

name: Torrential Couchout
description: Shuffle in short heavy steps within the square, never lifting the butt from its drag line.

name: Overbearing Steelcap
description: Cross the two hands' tracks in a sudden beat to rap a foe's weapon off its line.

name: Rumble Press
description: Split the qi in two tracks that meet in the point, doubling its biting force on contact.

name: Obdurate Pikeshaft
description: Brace the heavy pike with both qi tracks, spreading the shock of a charge between the hands.

name: Suffocating Pikehead
description: Swap the leading hand between thrusts so the foe cannot judge which side the point will come from.

name: Invincible Longpole
description: Pull the heavy shaft back on the rebound of a clash, its weight sweeping aside the counter.

name: Intentpress
description: Lean both tracks of qi into one long press that crushes a guard down and holds it there.

name: Facetshaft
description: Drive a heavy field-qi thrust into the face of a foe square so it splits his formation.

name: Rumble Present
description: Merge both tracks of field qi through the shaft into a single stroke of crushing weight.

name: Granite Pikecollar
description: Stand shoulder to shoulder with one partner so both pikes cover the same front.

name: Granite Levelhold
description: Jab sideways across your partner's flank to hit a foe who tries to slip round.

name: Siltshaft
description: Step out together with your partner in mirrored strides, widening the front by a pace.

name: Illuminating Mastlength
description: Lend a pulse of qi to your partner's shaft and cover the strain of his thrusts.

name: Ruinous Press
description: Thrust across your partner's line at the same foe so the two points meet at the target.

name: Thorn Steelcap
description: Close your shaft against your partner's to bind a foe's weapon between them.

name: Nova Ashstaff
description: Answer a thrust at your partner with a field-qi thrust from the other side of the pair.

name: Pikebands Tenacity
description: Interlock your guard with your partner's, qi binding both shafts into one hard barrier.

name: Reverberating Mastlength Ruin
description: Alternate thrust and guard with your partner in rounds of field qi that break a whole enemy line.

name: Pikehead Spine
description: Stand with the pike levelled on the open height and the wind at the shoulder.

name: Punishing Pikeshoe
description: Jab into the wind along a straight line, the headwind steadying the shaft.

name: Mightshaft
description: Advance at a sworn steady pace across open ground, the point never leaving its bearing.

name: Chime Pikeshaft
description: Sweep the shaft across the body as the plateau wind sweeps grass, turning aside a blade.

name: Booming Bristle
description: Drive a qi thrust with the wind behind it so the point bites deep into armour.

name: Ponderous Bristle
description: Bind a foe's weapon with the shaft and the oath that the point will not move.

name: Mastinsight
description: Open qi across the plateau with no walls to limit it and sense every foe approaching.

name: Footspike Devastation
description: Thrust with field qi and the full height's wind behind the pike, driving through shield and mail.

name: Thornpike
description: Brace on open ground with no wall behind and hold by oath against the heaviest push.

name: Longpole Scourge
description: Swear the oath to the wind and loose a field-qi thrust that carries a gale's force.

name: Mastdurance
description: Swear to keep the point levelled and set the shaft at chest height, holding it there.

name: Bracescourge
description: Jab from the levelled hold without dropping the point even a hand's width first.

name: Brace Blink
description: Step only along the straight line of the point, forward or back, never aside.

name: Mastrespite
description: Lock the wrists on contact so the point stays on the line through any shock.

name: Pikebands Hardihood
description: Parry by turning the levelled shaft a finger's width, letting the blow slide off.

name: Piercing Brace
description: Thrust from the held level with qi packed at the head, piercing before the foe can guard.

name: Hogtying Present
description: Press the levelled shaft onto a foe's weapon and hold it motionless by qi and oath.

name: Chime Ashstaff
description: Read the wind along the levelled shaft to sense the shape of anything that crosses it.

name: Glintpike
description: Take a shock on the levelled shaft and return it down the same line to its source.

name: Mangling Present
description: Thrust with field qi at full oath, the point driving straight through plate along the held line.

name: Pikemettle
description: Hold the levelled point against a charge so it spits on it, then press the broken rush.

name: Charter Longpole
description: Speak the full oath and drive the point forward on field qi, stopping a rush and piercing it.

name: Clairvoyant Pikehead
description: Glance at grass and banner to read the crosswind before taking a new bearing.

name: Torrent Levelhold
description: Pivot on the lead foot so the shaft swings onto a freshly taken bearing.

name: Shaftruin
description: Jab on a slant to allow for the crosswind so the point lands true.

name: Chime Steelcap
description: Turn the shaft into a sudden gust and let it push the cut aside for you.

name: Phantom Bristle
description: Slide the feet across to follow the shifted bearing, keeping the point's line unbroken.

name: Glint Mastlength
description: Drive qi along a slanted line with the crosswind, striking where the foe's guard does not reach.

name: Buoying Pikecollar
description: Call the new bearing through shared qi so neighbouring pikes turn together on the same line.

name: Mastmettle
description: Cross shafts over a foe's weapon and pin it as a gust pins a banner.

name: Siltbrace
description: Turn the whole pike line on a new bearing, qi keeping every shaft aligned through the pivot.

name: Reaching Footspike
description: Thrust with field qi carried on the crosswind so the point arrives from beyond the foe's guard.

name: Hour Pikeshaft
description: Vanish with the turning wind onto a new bearing and strike from where the foe is not looking.

name: Unassailable Pikeshoe
description: Grip the levelled pike firmly as a gale of foes presses, letting its weight settle.

name: Levelhold Devastation
description: Thrust steadily into the wind without a flourish, the shaft barely moving off its line.

name: Pressflash
description: Step forward directly into the rush, head low, with the pike angled over the shoulder.

name: Breaking Ashstaff
description: Thrust with qi into the front of a rush so the leading foe breaks the others' stride.

name: Inexorable Pikeshoe
description: Let the wind and a pulse of qi snap the shaft back to guard after a thrust.

name: Unerring Pikecollar
description: Read the pressure of the oncoming gale of foes along the shaft and find its weakest point.

name: Mayhem Brace
description: Sweep the pike across a crowding front with field qi and wind adding reach to the arc.

name: Ironshaft
description: Brace the pike by oath and field qi against the full weight of a charging crowd.

name: Silt Longpole
description: Wait out the gale then loose all the held qi in one great sweep that scatters the front.

name: Unconquered Pikehead
description: Stand at the plateau's lip with the pike levelled, so the drop behind forbids retreat.

name: Blaze Footspike
description: Jab from the plateau's edge into the face of a foe struggling up the slope.

name: Vanishing Bristle
description: Slide sideways along the plateau's lip without lifting the feet or lowering the point.

name: Toxinpress
description: Rap the lead rider's bridle or lance as the charge arrives, spoiling its line.

name: Torrent Ashstaff
description: Raise the shaft into the updraft from the cliff to turn a cut upward and aside.

name: Novamast
description: Brace on the plateau's edge and thrust with qi, the firm ground giving the point more bite.

name: Present Spine
description: Use the shaft as a lever to turn a charging horse's head toward the edge.

name: Hoarfrost Pikebands
description: Anchor the brace by the held bearing so the shock runs down into the plateau stone.

name: Mastering Couchout
description: Press a foe back toward the lip with the steady pressure of the point and a thread of qi.

name: Pikeshaft Havoc
description: Thrust with field qi from the braced edge, the point driving through armour with the ground behind it.

name: Ironpike
description: Set a brace of field qi that shatters the momentum of a charge in the instant of contact.

name: Blaze Levelhold
description: Sweep the pike along the plateau's edge by oath, qi lengthening the stroke across the whole front.

name: Steelcap Wrath
description: Hold the edge by oath until the charge arrives, then drive field qi through the point in one blow.

name: Unconquered Mastlength
description: Take the bearing on the foe and set the brace in the same breath, holding both.

name: Blaze Press
description: Jab along the bearing already taken so the point travels a line the foe has not seen.

name: Pikeflash
description: Step the rear foot into a new brace without shifting the bearing of the point.

name: Ashstaff Nerve
description: Answer a cut with a shaft turn that follows the wind, letting the blow pass.

name: Glintshaft
description: Thrust along the held bearing with qi packed in the head, piercing without wavering.

name: Pikecollar Spine
description: Feed the shock taken in the brace back up the shaft and surge it at the foe.

name: Thornbrace
description: Bind a foe's weapon with the shaft in the turn of the wind and hold it with qi.

name: Tempered Couchout
description: Thrust from a locked brace with field qi, the whole body's weight behind the point.

name: Shade Bristle
description: Hold the point against the foe's chest by the held bearing until his weapon sinks.

name: Shade Couchout
description: Pin the foe by bearing and brace, then loose field qi down the shaft in one piercing stroke.
